brief: Two pairs of bases. Bolt the two bases of each pair together, with no connector inside a pair. Put the pairs side by side and fit a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other.

requirements.evidence: Four full bases at level 0: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full form pair 1; piece:1,0,0;full, piece:1,1,0;full form pair 2. check_build topology shows two groups [[0,0, 0,1],[1,0, 1,1]].

jointBolt:0#0,0#0 sits on the wall between pair 1's bases (0,0|0,1) and jointBolt:0#1,1#3 sits on the wall between pair 2's bases (1,0|1,1). check_build lists both intra-pair walls (0,0|0,1 and 1,0|1,1) as 'bare' (no connector), each fastened by its joint bolt.
requirements.requirement: The two bases of each pair are bolted together, with no connector inside a pair

requirements.evidence: The two pairs sit side by side in one 2x2 block, sharing three touching walls: 0,0|1,0, 0,1|1,1 and the diagonal 0,1|1,0. All three carry side connectors: connector:0#0,0|1,0, connector:0#0,1|1,1, connector:0#0,1|1,0; check_build topology marks every one of those walls 'connector'.
requirements.requirement: Pairs side by side, with a side connector on every wall where one pair touches the other

requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 14 solid end caps on the open outer faces; lockJoints added bolts (jointBolt:0#0,0#5, jointBolt:0#0,1#1, jointBolt:0#1,0#5) so nothing slides apart. check_build passes with meshClash clear and no issues.
requirements.requirement: House rules: open faces capped and joints locked once parts are settled

finish.summary: Built a 2x2 block of four full bases at level 0, arranged as two pairs: pair 1 = (0,0)+(0,1), pair 2 = (1,0)+(1,1). Each pair is fastened internally by a joint bolt on its shared wall (jointBolt:0#0,0#0 and jointBolt:0#1,1#3) with no connector on either intra-pair wall. The pairs sit side by side and all three cross-pair walls (0,0|1,0, 0,1|1,1 and the diagonal 0,1|1,0) carry side-connector-single parts, so the configurator reports exactly two groups joined by connectors. Open outer faces were capped (14 caps) and remaining joints locked with extra bolts. check_build passes with meshClash clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups.
